headline: Gillanders Arbuthnot submits SEBI depositories certificate
summary: Gillanders Arbuthnot & Company Limited has submitted a compliance certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018 to the exchange. This is a routine regulatory filing confirming compliance with depository rules for the relevant period. Such periodic disclosures do not impact the company's financial operations or share price. Indian retail investors holding the stock face no direct financial consequence from this procedural update.
why_it_matters: No impact on retail holdings from routine regulatory paperwork.
